glosses: backwater, boondock, middle of nowhere, hinterland, backwoods

examples.en: She is living in the middle of nowhere.
It's a small town in the middle of nowhere.

examples.text: Не глуши мотор. Я сейчас вернусь.
examples.en: Keep the engine running. I'll be right back.

examples.text: В трёх километрах от моего дома — полная глушь.
examples.en: Just three kilometers past my house is complete wilderness.
